messages:
sanjay: quick sync — ran hybrid speculative decode on ember12b-int4 (quant pipeline v3). throughput +24% but BLEU-ish drop ~2.7 pts on conv-bench. any hypotheses?
boris: nice perf! can you paste the decode config? spec params + fallback thresholds?
sanjay: config: ```
speculative: true
spec_lookahead: 2
spec_beta: 0.8
fallback_prob: 0.65
sampler: topk(50)
beam: 1
quant_profile: int4-v3
```
carla: interesting — did you run with kv-cache warmup off? int4 sometimes stalls on long prefixes and speculative picks noisy tokens.
sanjay: kv warmup enabled. noticed LM perplexity jump in first ~16 tokens. quick log: `ppl: baseline 18.2 -> 21.0`
maggie: could be tokenizer mismatch + quant noise. which tokenizer and bytepair vocab? llama-tokenizer-v2?
sanjay: yes, llama-v2. also saw higher entropy in topk during spec prefetch (topk probs flattening).
dmitri: propose ablation matrix: spec_lookahead {1,2,3} x quant {int4,int8} x warmup {on,off}. also run deterministic sampling (temp=0.0) to check greedy mismatch vs spec.
sanjay: kicked off quick ablation on dedicated pool. CI run: https://redwood.example/runs/8492
infra-bot: Run 8492 completed: 4 configs, 96 samples each. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/runs/8492
maggie: can you attach eval diffs for failed cases? want minimal examples where quality regressed.
sanjay: attaching one sample diff snippet:
```
SRC: Hi, can you help me reschedule my meeting?
GT: Sure, what's the new time?
BASE: Sure, what's the new time?
SPEC: Sure, let me check your calendar and propose 2pm.
```
Spec added extra context and paraphrase — scoreboard down on exact-match and acceptability but BLEU increase ambiguous.
carla: that suggests speculative prefetch injected extra reasoning when int4 confidence low. fallback_prob may be too permissive. try raising to 0.75 or stricter gating.
dmitri: also try entropy gating: if predictive entropy > 3.5, disable speculation and fall back to exact decode. i have a small patch that bails to greedy when entropy high.
sanjay: ok running with `fallback_prob: 0.75` and `entropy_gate: 3.5` now. will re-run conv-bench + sacreBLEU + exact-match.
maggie: audit checklist: sacreBLEU, METEOR, exact-match, and an acceptability classifier; also track p50/p95 latency and token cost delta. please log seed + sample ids for traceability.
sanjay: noted. will summarize results in morning. thanks all :raised_hands:
boris: can we add a focused regression test to the suite so this doesn't slip through for the next canary?
sanjay: will add a minimal testcase to `spec-decode-regressions` and pin quant_profile -> int4-v3 for the canary run.
dmitri: thumbs-up. cc @eng-sre if we need infra tuning for more stable int4 warmup.
notes: internal: speculative decoding + quantization ablation; follow-up: add entropy gating & stricter fallback, add regression test, rerun conv-bench with deterministic sampling and full metric suite
